subject: reference-meson

arrangement.label: layered-asymmetric-media-overlap
arrangement.notes: Text block and a negative-margin-offset media block overlap; not a clean stack, not fullbleed, not a clean 50/50 split.

caseTreatment.label: small-caps-tag
caseTreatment.notes: Hero tag uses font-variant: small-caps, not text-transform uppercase, not sentence case.

character.label: press-and-lift
character.notes: Hover lifts with an offset hard shadow; active state presses down. Physical/stamp metaphor, not fade-rise/scale/parallax/stagger/instant.

depth.label: flat-with-hard-offset-accent
depth.notes: Mostly flat; the one hard-edged offset shadow on the CTA is a deliberate accent, not a general layered-shadow surface treatment.

freeformNotes: Media placeholder is a CSS gradient texture, explicitly labeled 'Foto de muestra' — no real photography exists, so media.dominantType/treatment are honestly 'unknown' rather than 'photography'.
